title: IDT Normalase Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Clean and quantify libraries
steps.instruction: Clean the amplified libraries and quantify them; ensure each sample has at least 5 µL at a concentration of 12 nM before proceeding to Normalization.

substeps.instruction: Measure concentration using a fluorometric or electrophoretic method.
Confirm volume ≥5 µL and concentration ≥12 nM.

steps.title: Confirm ligation reagents
steps.instruction: Verify that the library ligation was performed with either Normalase Reagent R5 (full‑length adapters) or stubby universal adapters followed by barcoded stubby Normalase adapters, as appropriate for your workflow.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the software interface as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the provided source and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any custom labware JSON files needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the supplied deck map, placing labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App’s calibration routine; refer to support articles for tips.

steps.title: Run protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the Normalase protocol.
